correctness.rationale: Anticanonical nefness, adjunction and the six multiplicity bounds reduce negative nonexceptional curves to degrees one and two; the five-point or six-point conics are excluded by collinearity and Bézout. The thirteen listed curves exhaust the negative curves. The D_i contract to the nodes; each E_ij is uniquely identified by which two D_i it meets, and each R by which two E curves it meets, so node permutations indeed determine the action on all thirteen labels. A stable negative-definite support descends as a reduced divisor sum T; for ample A, solve for a fixed correction to A orthogonal to the selected curves. The inverse of the negative intersection matrix has nonnegative entries after changing the sign, so the correction is effective and nef after adding it to A; A+mT for m large has the required negative support. The symmetric Cayley cubic has coordinate permutations realizing twists for every cycle partition. Exact independent enumeration by rational positive-definite principal-support recursion, rather than the published graph criterion, produced coefficient vectors totaling 726, 66, 74, 9, 8 and orbit size counts 1^3 3^5 4^6 6^6 12^28 24^13. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/reproductions/cayley.py. This concerns geometric support labels and characteristic at least five, not arbitrary arithmetic surfaces or an action of all S4 by rational automorphisms on each twist.

value.rationale: Frobenius-invariant chamber counts are a natural invariant, and the two equal individual-curve cycle partitions with different fixed-support totals are a lucid illustration. Here those exact facts and the histogram require only filtering and taking orbits of an already explicit labeled S4-equivariant finite support set. Under the standard for narrow exact invariants this mechanical evaluation does not establish an independently valuable surviving research claim, and no repair is justified.
